description: This file defines a custom exception class ResourceConflictException used to represent conflicts, such as uniqueness constraints violations, within the API error handling package of the Java backend.

classes.name: ResourceConflictException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating a conflict with a resource due to violation of constraints or state conflicts.

methods.name: ResourceConflictException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with resource type, conflict field, and an error message.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the type of resource involved in the conflict.

methods.name: getConflictField
methods.description: Returns the field that caused the conflict.
